card.title: Useful Enough to Stay
card.instruction: Make yourself constantly useful and read each response as evidence of whether you still belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've swept your kitchen. Anything else before I go?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just sit down. You're my guest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The chair could use a polish first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I'll talk while I polish. Two reasons to invite me again.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 explicit company invitation to add another reason A thinks will preserve belonging.
